sources.snippet: About Llama 3.1 8B Llama 3.1 8B is an efficient open foundation model by Meta engineered for multilingual dialogue, classification, and edge deployment across 8 languages. It features an expanded 128K token context window and enhanced tool-calling capabilities.

sources.snippet: Llama 3.1 represents a significant advancement in the Llama model series with extended context length (128K tokens), multilingual capabilities, and improved performance across various tasks. For information about other Llama model versions, see Llama 3.2, Llama 3.3, and Llama 4. For general model architecture details, see Model Architecture.
